summary: Warm buff sandstone with fine bedding lines and soft rust stains, weathered rough, as in cliffs, quarried blocks and old walls.
_comment: Weathered sandstone: sand grains cemented into rock, laid down in beds, cut and left to the weather (cliffs, quarried building stone, old walls). Opaque: a solid, rough dielectric. Base textures are generated (L2, tools/converters/base/gen_sandstone_weathered.py; the wish list planned a scan, L3, but ambientCG's sandstone assets are bricks, tiles and walls, assemblies rather than matter): laminae of random thickness (3 to 40 mm) grouped into beds, gently swaying and dipping, each fading in and out along its length, the harder ones standing slightly proud; soft iron mottling and a few curving iron bands across the beds; a sandy grit and grain, and small rounded weathering pits. The colour is a judgement, a warm buff (Physically Based has no sandstone entry; its Sand read khaki-olive on a stone face). Carries every relevant wear layer at 0 (C1): chipped edge wear (overlay 1, damage) and dust as a deposit (Phase10), gated by the Crevice mask; no third layer is relevant. Not carried: the wet and moss looks the wish list also wants. Built by the Phase11 batch.
name: Sandstone_Weathered_Clean_Base_s1_v01

sources.note: Sandstone is cemented sand: the entry's roughness 1.0 is the ceiling (the map's mean is 0.9, a weathered face keeping a trace of sheen on its quartz grains). Its colour (0.44, 0.386, 0.231) is not taken: it read khaki-olive on a stone face; see the judgement.

sources.why: Mean linear albedo (0.43, 0.31, 0.19), about sRGB 174, 151, 121, a warm buff sandstone; specular_ior 1.54, that of quartz (Physically Based 'Quartz'), sandstone's main mineral; the bedding, staining and pits as drawn by the generator. Physically Based has no sandstone entry.
